        attempt instead of compounding (``original_ms * (multiplier ** attempt)``).n        This means every retry gets the same timeout regardless of the
        attempt number, eliminating the exponential back-pressure that

            "original_ms": original_ms,

        self.history.setdefault("default", []).append(record)

        return {
            "original_ms": original_ms,
            "new_timeout_ms": new_timeout_ms,
            "attempt": attempt,
            "capped": new_timeout_ms >= self.ceiling_ms,

  "comments": "Fix compound escalation from original_ms * multiplier to original_ms * (multiplier ** attempt) and emit timeout.escalated metric for alerting system."
